dialogues.speaker: Kvashnina
dialogues.text: Oh, no. I was on assignment elsewhere and am now on my way back. Strictly speaking, this train isn't under my jurisdiction.

dialogues.speaker: Kvashnina
dialogues.text: But now that I've joined the Druzhna, I can't just ignore any signs of danger.

dialogues.speaker: Kvashnina
dialogues.text: If you notice anything suspicious, please let me know right away. I'll handle it.
